title: 菜
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Redraw the fantasy card 菜 / Noob as ONE completely new illustration; a novice who gains strong Block while becoming Weak. Landscape full-bleed 1000x790 pixels. The input is reference-only for identity/costume/painting style: same ADULT young man, tousled ash-blond hair, amber eyes, cobalt-blue hood/scarf, fitted layered black outfit and black gloves. NEW COMPOSITION AND EMOTION: in a wooden training yard he has clumsily stumbled into a low awkward squat, knees bent and weight uncertain, eyes wide and embarrassed, raised eyebrows, one sweat drop, mouth making an anxious lopsided grimace. Pull his black mask down under the chin so the sheepish novice expression is clearly visible. His left arm nervously clutches a SMALL battered wooden round training shield held awkwardly sideways; his right hand grabs the top of his hood in panic. His cheap wooden practice sword has fallen on the ground in front of him. A single harmless blunt practice arrow bounces away from a surprisingly enormous golden translucent protective dome projecting from the tiny shield. A faint purple weakening ribbon around his left forearm suggests weakened attack ability. Strong visual joke: he is clearly bad at combat and panicking, but accidentally very well protected. The frightened/embarrassed man, dropped wooden sword, tiny shield and magical dome must be readable at thumbnail size. Do not give him a cool confident sword stance, ornate metal tower shield or heroic attack; do not recreate the previous successful warrior composition. Adult proportions, not chibi; one coherent body, exactly two arms and two hands, two legs, natural joints and fingers, no duplicated limbs or additional characters. Keep his face, shield and both hands in frame. Match sharp Japanese-anime fantasy impasto/painterly angular brushwork, saturated royal/cobalt blue, deep black shadows and amber-gold rim light. No readable text, title, numbers, speech bubbles, UI, borders, logos, watermarks or split panels. Opaque painted background to every edge. Deliver one finished PNG.

nameAnchors: 睁大眼汗颜、露齿紧张表情
effectAnchors: 小木盾与独立巨大金色屏障
visualReview.observed: 角色一手护头、另一手笨拙举小木盾，坐倒蜷缩、练习木剑掉落；大屏障挡住训练箭，明确表现生疏但防御很强。
visualReview.style: 灰金发、琥珀眼、蓝兜帽黑服和蓝金厚涂延续原卡图；面罩下拉以显示窘迫表情。
visualReview.anatomy: 两手分别位于头顶和盾后，两臂连贯，两腿一伸一屈，靴子接位自然；拇指受姿态遮挡合理，无明显多余肢体。

independentVisualReview.observed: 已实际查看1000×790最终图，慌张新手感、小木盾/大屏障/落剑、紫带均明确；未见需返工的实质问题。
